item.title: Russian drone hits train near Ukraine-Poland border soon after dignitaries passed through
item.description: A Russian drone struck a train near the Ukraine-Poland border shortly after senior visiting officials, including the former prime ministers of the U.K. and Sweden, passed through.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Amazon suspends use of 21 Air, cargo carrier whose plane careened off Miami runway
item.description: Amazon said it's decided to pause operations with 21 Air as the investigation into the crash continues. North Carolina-based 21 had flown packages for Amazon since 2024.
item.content:encoded:

(Image credit: Marta Lavandier)

item.title: Pennsylvania says an unvaccinated woman has died from measles-related complications
item.description: Pennsylvania has announced its third measles-related death in less than three weeks. A local coroner says the 40-year-old woman was unvaccinated.
item.content:encoded:
Pennsylvania has announced its third measles-related death in less than three weeks. A local coroner says the 40-year-old woman was unvaccinated.

item.title: Trump downplays calls for AI slowdown
item.description: President Trump said the dire warnings about AI were exaggerated and that "negative forces" are making claims about things that won't happen. This comes after leaders in the industry called for putting the brakes on AI development.

item.title: Can Gulf states and Iran negotiate the Strait of Hormuz without the U.S.?
item.description: Dania Thafer of the Gulf International Forum weighs in on previously scheduled talks between Iran and Gulf states. Shortly before this interview aired, Oman announced that the talks were postponed.

item.title: Wisconsin congressman survives emergency plane landing, swims to safety
item.description: Wisconsin Congressman Tom Tiffany escaped a sinking plane and swam to shallow water after an emergency landing in a lake. Tiffany and the pilot called 911 from on top of the plane.

item.title: Actor Tatyana Ali is advocating for Black and Indigenous maternal health
item.description: Actor Tatyana Ali says her healing journey after a traumatic childbirth has inspired her advocacy for Black maternal health, including support for midwives, doulas and other birth workers.

item.description: Following the midterm convention in Dallas, President Trump's $5,000 campaign promise has generated attention, but not belief. And, Vice President JD Vance characterizes Democrats as extremists.
